overview_description.description:
We're a fast-growing Y-Combinator (S15) backed startup, based in New York.

Hickory is the only training tool focused on retention, turning Sales and Customer Service staff into brand experts. The app predicts when a rep will forget what they’ve learned, and schedules review exercises tailored to their strengths and weaknesses to prevent that from happening.

about_short_description.short_description: Hickory is a training tool that focuses on retention which helps you hire more people capable of being experts at their position.

product.name: Hickory Training Platform
product.description: A cloud-based learning management system that imports, organizes, and deploys training content via multiple channels to improve employee retention and expertise.

product.name: Content Library and Editor
product.description: A tool for creating, importing, and organizing training materials using a card-based editor supporting drag-and-drop of various file types and SCORM imports.

identifier.value: Automated Course Assignment and Review System

product.name: Automated Course Assignment and Review System
product.description: A system that assigns courses to users, triggers reviews based on spaced repetition, and automates notifications and reporting to track learning progress.

product.name: Integration and Deployment Services
product.description: Services that enable deployment of training content across multiple platforms and integration with existing sign-in systems and communication tools.
